raw_problem.solution_text:
根据提示

$$
[ z, [ H, z ] ] = [ z, H z - z H ] = z H z - z ^ {2} H - H z ^ {2} + z H z = 2 z H z - H z ^ {2} - z ^ {2} H,
$$

所以，

$$
z H z = \frac {1}{2} \left\{\left[ z, [ H, z ] \right] + z ^ {2} H + H z ^ {2} \right\}.
$$

先求花括号中对易项的具体表达式

$$
\begin{array}{l} [ H, z ] = \left[ \frac {1}{2 m} \left(p _ {x} ^ {2} + p _ {y} ^ {2} + p _ {z} ^ {2}\right) + V (x, y, z), z \right] \\ = \left[ \frac {1}{2 m} \left(p _ {x} ^ {2} + p _ {y} ^ {2} + p _ {z} ^ {2}\right), z \right] + \left[ V \left(x, y, z\right), z \right]. \\ \end{array}
$$

由于 $V \left( x , y , z \right)$ 只是坐标的函数，所以 $V \left( x , y , z \right)$ 与坐标对易，即 $\left[ V \left( x , y , z \right) , z \right] = 0$ 又

$$
[ p _ {x}, z ] = 0, [ p _ {y}, z ] = 0,
$$

故

$$
\begin{array}{l} [ H, z ] = \left[ \frac {p _ {z} ^ {2}}{2 m}, z \right] \\ = \frac {1}{2 m} \left\{p _ {z} [ p _ {z}, z ] + [ p _ {z}, z ] p _ {z} \right\} \\ = \frac {1}{2 m} \left\{p _ {z} (- \mathrm {i} \hbar) + (- \mathrm {i} \hbar) p _ {z} \right\} \\ \end{array}
$$

$$
= - \frac {\mathrm {i} \hbar}{m} p _ {z}.
$$

所以，

$$
\begin{array}{l} [ z, [ H, z ] ] = \left[ z, - \frac {\mathrm {i} \hbar}{m} p _ {z} \right] \\ = - \frac {\mathrm {i} \hbar}{m} [ z, p _ {z} ] \\ = \frac {\hbar^ {2}}{m}. \\ \end{array}
$$

因此，

$$
z H z = \frac {1}{2} \left\{\frac {\hbar^ {2}}{m} + z ^ {2} H + H z ^ {2} \right\}.
$$

由习题 4.15(b) 知，在氢原子基态情况下，

$$
\left\langle x ^ {2} \right\rangle = \left\langle y ^ {2} \right\rangle = \left\langle z ^ {2} \right\rangle = \frac {1}{3} \left\langle r ^ {2} \right\rangle = a ^ {2},
$$

所以，

$$
\begin{array}{l} \langle z H z \rangle = \frac {1}{2} \left\{\langle \psi_ {1} | \frac {\hbar^ {2}}{m} | \psi_ {1} \rangle + \langle \psi_ {1} | z ^ {2} H | \psi_ {1} \rangle + \langle \psi_ {1} | H z ^ {2} | \psi_ {1} \rangle \right\} \\ = \frac {1}{2} \left\{\frac {\hbar^ {2}}{m} + E _ {1} \left\langle \psi_ {1} \right| z ^ {2} \left| \psi_ {1} \right\rangle + \left\langle H \psi_ {1} \right| z ^ {2} \left| \psi_ {1} \right\rangle \right\} \\ = \frac {1}{2} \left\{ \right.\frac {\hbar^ {2}}{m} + E _ {1} \left<   \psi_ {1} \left. \right| z ^ {2} \left| \psi_ {1} \right> + E _ {1} \left<   \psi_ {1} \right| z ^ {2} \left| \right. \psi_ {1} \right>\left. \right\} \\ = \frac {\hbar^ {2}}{2 m} + E _ {1} a ^ {2} \\ = \frac {\hbar^ {2}}{2 m} - \frac {\hbar^ {2}}{2 m a ^ {2}} a ^ {2} \\ = 0. \\ \end{array}
$$
